spec.userPrompt:
Question: Infinitif ou « que + subjonctif » ? Complétez : « Je veux ___ avec mes amis ce weekend. »

Choices:
A. [MARKED CORRECT] partir
B. que je parte
C. que nous partions
D. que je pars

responses.raw:
VERDICT: TRUE
REASON: After "vouloir," when the subject of the main clause and the dependent verb is the same ("je" wants "je" to leave), the infinitive "partir" is required rather than "que + subjonctif."

VERDICT: TRUE
REASON: "Vouloir" takes an infinitive directly when the subject wants to perform the action themselves, so "Je veux partir" is the correct construction; "vouloir que + subjonctif" would only be used when wanting someone else to do something.
